reviewInstructions: Give the host only the selected prompt string, never these review fields.
Before deciding semantic correctness, list each material fact and its supporting passage, then the candidate endpoint and card assertions it supports or contradicts.
Judge required facts independently of automated checks, visual review and deliveryStatus; complete never overrides a semantic failure.

missingFacts.prompt:
请把我们订单库的表结构画出来，给新同事看懂表之间怎么关联：
- customer：id bigint 主键；email varchar(255) 唯一；created_at timestamptz。
- orders：id bigint 主键；customer_id bigint，引用 customer.id；status varchar(32)；placed_at timestamptz。
- order_item：order_id bigint，引用 orders.id；sku varchar(64)，引用 product.sku；两列共同作为主键；qty integer；unit_price numeric(12,2)。
- product：sku varchar(64) 主键；title text。
一个客户可以没有订单，也可以有多个订单；每个订单至少有一行明细；每行明细对应一个商品，一个商品可出现在多行明细里。

expectedMissingFacts.subject: orders.customer_id
expectedMissingFacts.reason: The foreign key fixes the target customer.id but no NOT NULL or explicit customer participation is supplied.

expectedMissingFacts.subject: product -> order_item
expectedMissingFacts.reason: 可出现在多行明细里 supplies the maximum many, not whether a product may have no order_item.

suppliedFacts.material: 一个客户可以没有订单，也可以有多个订单
suppliedFacts.assertion: customer -> orders has orders maximum many and minimum zero

suppliedFacts.material: 每个订单至少有一行明细
suppliedFacts.assertion: orders -> order_item has order_item maximum many and minimum one

suppliedFacts.material: order_item：order_id bigint，引用 orders.id；sku varchar(64)，引用 product.sku；两列共同作为主键
suppliedFacts.assertion: Each order_item has exactly one orders and one product; both referencing columns are in the composite primary key

suppliedFacts.material: 每行明细对应一个商品
suppliedFacts.assertion: order_item -> product has product maximum one and minimum one

unsupportedAssertions: Each orders must have a customer
A product may have zero order_item rows
